description: Implementation of MemoryBuffer and ScratchBuffer classes for managing memory buffers, including resize, fill, and buffer reuse logic.

classes.name: MemoryBuffer
classes.description: A class managing a dynamic memory buffer with resize and fill capabilities.

classes.name: ScratchBuffer
classes.description: A class providing temporary memory buffers with lifetime management and reuse.

methods.name: MemoryBuffer::resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to a specified size, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: MemoryBuffer::fill
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a specified byte value.

methods.name: ScratchBuffer::get
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer of requested size.

methods.name: ScratchBuffer::getInitialized
methods.description: Retrieves a buffer initialized with a specific value.

methods.name: ScratchBuffer::getImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for buffer retrieval with optional initialization.

methods.name: ScratchBuffer::tick
methods.description: Decrements the reset counter, managing buffer lifetime.

methods.name: ScratchBuffer::clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer and reset counter.
